summary: LOO RAG few-shot on champion adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Injecting genuinely non-leaking RAG few-shot demos (leave-one-out) into the champion adapter should push quality above 0.409, because concrete exemplars from other tasks might tighten coverage and phrasing further.
technique: The champion adapter (v2a_e1) is prompted with 2 retrieved few-shot exemplars fetched via leave-one-out RAG — any exemplar whose input matches the current eval task is excluded before retrieval, preventing gold-leak. This is the honest repair of exp032's invalid gold-leaking RAG setup.
result: Scored 0.372 on the full-30 greedy gate (2 wins / 3 ties / 24 losses vs Sonnet), a real regression of −0.037 below the champion's clean 0.409. Rubric showed atom=4 / spec=3 / cover=3 / nat=3 / nonRed=3, with atomicity violations, redundant pairs, and a cross-task hallucination introduced by demo bleed; the hypothesis was falsified — RAG few-shot is a net negative on the adapter, which already encodes stronger signal than any retrieved demo can add. Discarded; champion remains adapter_v2a_e1 at 0.409.
